name: flouna-monorepo
description: Flouna - AI decision engine for food & rides

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "server,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "server,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix web run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
